summary: Fun beauty salon game for children to create amazing hairstyles and looks!
description:
Welcome to the best hair salon in town! Are you ready to create countless styles and set trends? Customers are waiting for a makeover!

In this free beauty salon game kids will find everything they need to let their imagination run wild and have hours of fun.  Dare to use all the tools, from the essentials like the hair dryer, comb and scissors to the straightener to straighten or curl their hair. Discover also the magic conditioner that makes your hair grow as long as you want.

Create amazing hairstyles and make your clients look more beautiful than ever! Wash the head with the shampoo to get all the shine out of the hair. Dry it with the help of the blow dryer and towel and decide on the haircut you will do. You can also dye the hair the color you want in a quick and easy way. Fun is guaranteed in this free beauty game. Create the most beautiful hairstyles in the world and become the best hairdresser!  

Do you want to create a daring look, or do you prefer something more classic? This hairdressing game is an interesting educational game in which children have to manage their own salon.  A perfect pastime to stimulate children's creativity and decision making. To work on these skills children can choose the models and decide what kind of look to give to the cute characters making all the changes they want. 

When you're done, stop by the photo booth, take a picture of the look you've made to keep and show it to all your friends or family. If the result doesn't suit you, don't worry! In this hair salon you have endless opportunities to change the look of all the fun drawings. 

FEATURES OF MY HAIR SALON
- Hairdressing game for boys and girls.
- Make all the changes you want.
- Variety of tools to create incredible hairstyles.
- Ideal to stimulate imagination and creativity.
- Fun and educational game!
